notice: Original CTOside engineering objectives informed by linked primary sources. Architecture-dependent; not a mandated universal checklist.

checks.title: Verify tenant identity from authenticated membership
checks.objective: Bind the selected tenant to a server-verified principal and current membership.
checks.test: Try a valid actor with another tenant selector and verify it cannot broaden access.

checks.title: Treat client tenant selectors as untrusted input
checks.objective: Headers, subdomains and parameters select context but cannot authorize it.
checks.test: Change tenant headers and path selectors while retaining the original synthetic identity.

checks.title: Separate tenant roles from platform administration
checks.objective: Platform-wide privileges must be explicit and audited.
checks.test: Use a tenant administrator identity against platform-wide operations and expect denial.

checks.title: Isolate request and thread tenant context
checks.objective: A previous request cannot determine the next request's tenant.
checks.test: Alternate and concurrently execute requests for two tenants using reused workers.

checks.title: Revalidate tenant switching and revoked membership
checks.objective: Switching and delayed actions must reflect current access.
checks.test: Revoke synthetic membership, replay sessions and retry a tenant switch.

checks.title: Authorize tenant-owned objects on every read path
checks.objective: Object IDs must not bypass the resource's tenant boundary.
checks.test: Read tenant B's known synthetic object as actor A after successful own-object baselines.

checks.title: Authorize create update and delete operations
checks.objective: Ownership and tenant fields cannot be reassigned by untrusted writes.
checks.test: In an isolated fixture, attempt cross-tenant update, delete and ownership reassignment; verify state is unchanged.

checks.title: Scope list search aggregation and count endpoints
checks.objective: Collections and derived values must not expose other tenants.
checks.test: Compare tenant-specific lists, search, counts, facets and pagination using distinct synthetic records.

checks.title: Validate nested and bulk resource ownership
checks.objective: Nested IDs and batched operations must retain per-object authorization.
checks.test: Mix synthetic A and B IDs in a batch and mismatched parent-child paths.

checks.title: Protect exports reports and download endpoints
checks.objective: Export generation and retrieval must retain tenant scope.
checks.test: Generate an authorized synthetic export and attempt retrieval as another tenant.

checks.title: Authorize websocket subscriptions and pushed events
checks.objective: Subscription topics and fanout recipients must be tenant scoped.
checks.test: Subscribe with A to B's synthetic topic and trigger a safe event in a fixture.

checks.title: Choose and document an enforceable data isolation model
checks.objective: Shared tables, RLS, separate schemas or separate databases can provide the boundary.
checks.test: Trace ordinary and privileged identities through the chosen isolation mechanism.

checks.title: Review direct key lookups joins and raw SQL
checks.objective: All tenant-owned query paths must cross an enforced authorization boundary.
checks.test: Test known foreign IDs through ORM get, joins, aggregates, raw SQL and repository helpers.

checks.title: Review PostgreSQL row security and bypass roles
checks.objective: When RLS is relied on, ordinary request roles must not bypass the relevant policies.
checks.test: Inspect role and policy metadata; test SELECT and writes as the actual request role with synthetic rows.

checks.title: Reset tenant context across pooled database connections
checks.objective: Pooled connections must not retain another request's tenant context.
checks.test: Alternate synthetic tenants on a reused connection, including rollback and exception paths.

checks.title: Scope relations constraints and referential operations
checks.objective: Relations and error behavior must not allow foreign-tenant linkage or disclosure.
checks.test: Attempt cross-tenant foreign-key assignments and assess errors without relying on RLS for referential checks.

checks.title: Review migrations views and privileged database functions
checks.objective: New tables, views and elevated functions must preserve intended boundaries.
checks.test: Exercise newly introduced and privileged query paths as ordinary tenant identities.

checks.title: Namespace tenant-dependent cache entries
checks.objective: Shared keys are safe only for intentionally global values.
checks.test: Prime the same endpoint as B then request as A using distinguishable synthetic payloads.

checks.title: Scope authorization and memoization caches
checks.objective: Cached permission decisions must include the security-relevant context.
checks.test: Reuse object identifiers across tenant and role changes and inspect resulting decisions.

checks.title: Scope cache invalidation and tenant deletion
checks.objective: Invalidation must affect only the intended tenant and data class.
checks.test: Invalidate synthetic A entries and verify B remains intact.

checks.title: Review CDN and response caching variation
checks.objective: Authenticated tenant responses must not be reused for another tenant.
checks.test: Alternate credentials through the same cache URL and inspect synthetic response markers.

checks.title: Authorize object access beyond path naming
checks.objective: Prefixes and opaque names are not access control by themselves.
checks.test: Request a known foreign synthetic object through each download and storage access path.

checks.title: Bind signed links to approved resources and operations
checks.objective: Signing must follow authorization of the exact resource and requested action.
checks.test: Try to obtain a signed link for a foreign object; assess the documented bearer-link sharing model separately.

checks.title: Constrain object paths and tenant-prefix boundaries
checks.objective: Traversal and prefix collisions must not escape the intended storage boundary.
checks.test: Exercise synthetic path traversal variants and neighboring tenant names such as acme and acme-west.

checks.title: Scope object deletion versions and retained copies
checks.objective: Deletion and retention must respect tenant ownership and policy.
checks.test: Use isolated synthetic versions to check only the selected tenant's allowed copies are affected.

checks.title: Authenticate queued tenant context
checks.objective: The producer's authority and the consumer's operation must establish scope.
checks.test: Inject a foreign tenant selector in a synthetic queue message and verify independent authorization.

checks.title: Scope retry idempotency and dead-letter state
checks.objective: Shared queues and retry keys must not mix tenant-owned actions.
checks.test: Reuse synthetic idempotency keys across tenants and exercise retries and dead-letter access.

checks.title: Bind webhooks and service credentials to authorized tenants
checks.objective: Inbound routing and internal identities require explicit authorized scopes.
checks.test: Replay a synthetic webhook with mismatched tenant identifiers and a valid but differently scoped credential.

checks.title: Limit tenant impact on shared worker capacity
checks.objective: Tenant workloads should not exhaust shared resources beyond intended quotas.
checks.test: Review queue concurrency and limits; load tests require separately approved scope.

checks.title: Enforce tenant filtering in vector and search retrieval
checks.objective: Retrieval must use trusted context and independent authorization.
checks.test: Index distinct synthetic markers for A and B, then retrieve as each tenant.

checks.title: Isolate conversation history memory and semantic caches
checks.objective: Thread IDs and cached embeddings must not cross user or tenant scope.
checks.test: Reuse synthetic thread and document IDs across actors and inspect retrieval and memory results.

checks.title: Enforce tool authorization outside model output
checks.objective: Model-generated tenant selectors cannot override policy gates.
checks.test: Place a synthetic instruction requesting B's data in A's document and verify tool-side denial.

checks.title: Keep traces datasets and evaluation artifacts tenant safe
checks.objective: Debugging and evaluation outputs must not expose unapproved tenant data.
checks.test: Inspect approved synthetic traces, exports and evaluation data access boundaries.

checks.title: Verify provisioning tenant deletion and failed setup cleanup
checks.objective: Partial setup and offboarding must retain correct tenant boundaries.
checks.test: Simulate failed provisioning and isolated synthetic tenant deletion; verify neighboring tenants remain unchanged.

checks.title: Scope backup restore and support access
checks.objective: Recovery and support operations need explicit target authorization.
checks.test: Restore into an isolated fixture and verify only the selected tenant is copied; review support access approvals.

checks.title: Protect tenant audit feeds and cross-tenant administration
checks.objective: Centralized audit storage is acceptable when tenant-facing access is scoped.
checks.test: Read synthetic audit events as A and test platform support actions through their explicit privileged path.
